run.name: Tenet Healthcare Corp
run.title: CP-OS host session (THC)
run.summary: Tenet has a sound near-term credit profile: net debt is 2.11x last-twelve-month Adjusted EBITDA and liquidity is 4,574, but earnings quality, partner leakage and payer-mix and policy risk limit the view. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context; the EDGAR registrant name in that context is TENET HEALTHCARE CORP.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Total debt 13,243 and cash 2,674 at September 30, 2026 over LTM Adjusted EBITDA 5,004 (FY2025 4,566 plus 9M 2026 3,821 less 9M 2025 3,383); includes a 147 favorable Q3 2026 effect; net result equals management's reported 2.11x

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. LTM Adjusted EBITDA 5,004 over LTM cash interest 830 (FY2025 865 plus 9M 2026 464 less 9M 2025 499); coupon timing is semi-annual so LTM is used rather than a single quarter

cash.basis: Cash. Same basis; the separate 200 letter-of-credit facility (105 of standby letters of credit outstanding) is letter-of-credit capacity only and is excluded; availability is borrowing-base driven and equals the 1,900 commitment

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Executed credit documents, ownership documents and the CommonSpirit agreement are not supplied, so covenant headroom and distribution capacity are unproven.
CP-1 main limitation: Adjusted EBITDA is a management measure before noncontrolling holders, and executed credit documents are not supplied.
